lines.en: I pace two laps around the little house.
Joints oiled, my walk is light.
Stone steps underfoot, clunk clunk.

lines.zh: 从桌边走到书架，再走回来。
lines.en: Table to shelf, and back again.
I stay inside this yard.
Slow steps — don't crack the floorboards.
I walk counting the tiles.

lines.zh: 脚步有节奏，像在上发条。
lines.en: My steps keep a winding rhythm.
Checking the window's shut.

lines.zh: 图纸摊在桌上，我去看看。
lines.en: The drawings are spread out. Let me look.
To the doorway, then pause.
Half a lap along the wall.

lines.zh: 这双腿是金属的，走多久都行。
lines.en: Metal legs — I can walk all day.
Pour tea, then walk back and sit.
Around back to check the furnace.
Walking is thinking time.
Sitting still, pen frozen above the page.
Good light from the window. Good for drawing.

lines.zh: 这具身体的关节在轻轻响。
lines.en: My joints tick softly.

lines.zh: 我在想下一页该画什么。
lines.en: Wondering what to draw on the next page.
Tea's gone cold and untouched.
Any students? The door hasn't sounded.
My pen is mightier than a blade.
Glance at the sky, then down again.

lines.zh: 这屋子安静得让人舒服。
lines.en: This room's quiet is pleasant.
Folding the drawings away.
Metal fingers tap the desk.
Someone has to write the stories down.
You've come. Come sit down.

lines.zh: 你身上的气看着很新鲜。
lines.en: Your aura looks quite fresh.

lines.zh: 看你走路的样子，是个新手。
lines.en: The way you walk — you're new at this.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等学生等很久了。
lines.en: I've waited a long time for a student.

lines.zh: 别拘束，桌子那边有椅子。
lines.en: Don't be stiff — there's a chair by the table.
What would you like to learn from me?

lines.zh: 我看得出你心里在犹豫。
lines.en: I can see the hesitation in you.
Sitting that far, can you hear me?

lines.zh: 你来得正好，我正想找人说话。
lines.en: Good timing — I wanted someone to talk to.
Hold out your hands and let me see.
Oh dear, a part came loose.
I can't stand. Give me a hand.
A plate's dented.
You don't hold back.
These old bones aren't sturdy.
It doesn't hurt. Just rattles.
Let me sit a moment.
A joint's stuck. I can't move.
This'll take a while to repair.
Tea is enough. Keep the food.
I don't eat. Thank you.
Pastries? Set them on the table.

lines.zh: 我闻不出味道，但心意收下。
lines.en: I can't smell it, but I accept it.
Is the pot still warm?
I'll remember what you brought.
Leave the food to you young ones.
My stomach is an iron box.
The tea's warmth I can feel.
Sit and share it. No ceremony.
Mind the table — the drawings will scatter.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头经不起撞。
lines.en: These old bones don't take bumps.
Just a step to the side.
You stepped on my shoe.
Careful, it's cramped in here.
I'm steady. Don't worry.
The sill's high — lift your foot.

lines.zh: 撞一下没什么，别撞第二下。
lines.en: One bump is fine. Not two.
You're in a hurry. Sit down.
Don't push me into the shelves.
My whole life has been drawings.
I have none of that.
Iron bodies don't build households.
My students are my concern.
Ask me something else.

lines.zh: 我把心思都放在故事里。
lines.en: My heart is in the stories.
I'm very old now.
I can't answer that one.
Go ask someone living.
My companion is this pen.
Pick it up and hand it here.
This pen still writes.
A scrap of paper — don't throw it.
Whose button is this?
Bending isn't easy for me.
Pick the book up off the floor.
This stone will weigh the paper down.
Don't pick up anything sharp.
Keep this as a memento.
Once it's picked up, sit.

lines.zh: 我不打架，但你靠太近了。
lines.en: I don't fight, but you're far too close.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就要关门了。
lines.en: One more step and I shut the door.
At my age I can't raise a hand.
If you mean to strike, I won't stop you.
This room is my classroom.
I set the pen down and look at you.

lines.zh: 你的气变了，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Your aura changed. I feel it.
Don't turn this place into a battlefield.
If you must try, I'll watch.
Hold it — don't step on my drawings.
I don't dodge, and needn't.
Your ki is still too loose.

lines.zh: 看你的重心，你还没站稳。
lines.en: Look at your balance — you're not set.
One lesson: breathe first.

lines.zh: 你的架势是我三十年前画的。
lines.en: I drew that stance thirty years ago.
Raise that hand a bit. Much better.
If you strike, I won't stop you.
Look me in the eye.
That step was already a mistake.
I have no weapon, only a pen.
A book is enough to block.
I won't hit back. Stop.
That swing wasn't steady.
You shoved the chairs over. A pity.
I step back to the shelf.
I won't replace what you break.
Young one, you're spending force wrongly.
I raise a hand only to block.
If you're tired, sit down.

lines.zh: 我从屋里走出来，掸了掸袖子。
lines.en: I step out and brush my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这间小屋就是我的全部。
lines.en: This little house is my whole world.
The door's open. I'm waiting for students.
I set the stools in place.
New sketches on the table.

lines.zh: 关节响了一声，我站定了。
lines.en: A joint clicks. I stand still.
I wipe my hands and come over.

lines.zh: 这屋子里只有纸和墨的味道。
lines.en: This room smells only of ink and paper.
Someone calling me outside?
Fire has blackened my shell.

lines.zh: 摔下来，腿里的齿轮错位。
lines.en: Falling knocked a gear out of line.

lines.zh: 水进了关节，我动起来嘎吱响。
lines.en: Water in my joints — I creak.
The blast flung me against the wall.

lines.zh: 一枚飞来的东西嵌进胸口。
lines.en: Something flew in and lodged in my chest.

lines.zh: 咒力滑过铁皮，却搅了线路。
lines.en: Magic slid off the plate but scrambled my wiring.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，可电池也在耗尽。
lines.en: I don't eat, but my cell still drains.
The current left me twitching.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，什么都抓不住。
lines.en: Falling, with nothing to grab.
